items.title: 1.1.1.1 Function Parameters and Return Values (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of parameters and return values (PDF 46-47).

blocks.text: Functions kai parameters le sakte aur return se qeemat lauta sakte hain. Function ko mukhtalif arguments ke saath kai baar bulaya ja sakta hai, ek hi code dobara istemal kar ke (Did You Know).

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)

blocks.prompt: Class activity: aisa function banayein jo adad ki list le kar sab se bara lautaye.
blocks.explanation: def biggest(nums): big = nums[0]; for n in nums: if n > big: big = n; return big. Python ka built-in max(nums) bhi yahi karta hai.

items: Parameters input lete hain; return nateeja wapas bhejta hai: add(2, 3) = 5.
